title: Ordinary tensor-pullback composition on total complexes after localization
statement: Let X,Y,Z be schemes [def-pc-scheme], f:X→Y and g:Y→Z. Work with the recorded derived localizations [def-pc-derived-category], tensor pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback] and their pinned adjunctions [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. For arbitrary complexes P,N of O_Z-modules, let psi:g*Tot(P,N)≅Tot(g*P,g*N), theta:f*Tot(g*P,g*N)≅Tot(f*g*P,f*g*N), and phi:(fg)*Tot(P,N)≅Tot((fg)*P,(fg)*N) have the canonical ordinary tensorator [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor] on each summand. Let beta be the homotopy-category composition mate of pushforwardComp. Write mu for the canonical localization tensor comparison [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison]. Then (Qh(beta_P) tensor Qh(beta_N));mu_direct = mu_successive;Q(theta inverse);Q(f*(psi inverse));Qh(beta_Tot);Q(phi). No K-flatness, derived pullback tensorator or derived counit occurs.

source.place: Tags 079U and 0D5S: ordinary total-complex tensorator and composition identification; parent normalization proof step 2, with localization tensor naturality.

proof.text: Let beta be the canonical ordinary composition mate under the pinned tensor-pullback adjunctions. Apply finiteStructure_tensorComparison_composition with k = f followed by g. The equality-transport pushforwardCongr rfl is the identity, and the inverse component of tensorPullbackCompositionIso is exactly beta: both are the same conjugateEquiv applied to pushforwardComp.inv. This gives the ordinary module tensor-composition square. Naturality of beta and the supplied summand equations for psi, theta and phi give the chain-map square on every (p,q) summand. Since the two pullbacks are left adjoints, mapped total-complex summand inclusions are jointly epimorphic; hence the ordinary chain maps agree.

Apply naturality of the canonical localization tensor comparison to beta at P and N, and localize the preceding ordinary chain-map equality. Solve the ordinary chain equality for Tot(beta_P,beta_N) by precomposing with theta inverse followed by f*(psi inverse), then substitute its localization into the naturality equation. Functoriality and the two inverse laws give the displayed equation. This uses neither K-flatness nor derived pullback tensorators or counits. Identity arrows, zero complexes and empty schemes obey the same formulas.

    (ψ : ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (g)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj

      pullbackTensorTotal Y
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (g)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)

      letI := SheafOfModules.preservesZeroMorphisms_curriedTensor_obj Y.sheaf

        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (g)).map

      (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))) (.up ℤ) p q n h) ≫

        ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.module_pullback_tensor (g)))

      ℤ)).obj P) (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj N)) ≅

      g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
      g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj N) (curriedTensor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings
      Y.toRingedSpace))) (.up ℤ) p q n h) ≫

        ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.module_pullback_tensor (f)))
          ((((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P).X p)
      ((((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj N).X q)).hom ≫

            (curriedTensor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)))
            (.up ℤ) p q n h)
    (φ : ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (f ≫ g)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj

        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (f ≫ g)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (f ≫ g)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj N))
    (hφ :
      letI := pullbackDescentModuleTensor Z
      letI := pullbackDescentModuleTensor X
      letI := SheafOfModules.preservesZeroMorphisms_curriedTensor Z.sheaf
      letI := SheafOfModules.preservesZeroMorphisms_curriedTensor X.sheaf
      letI := SheafOfModules.preservesZeroMorphisms_curriedTensor_obj Z.sheaf
      letI := SheafOfModules.preservesZeroMorphisms_curriedTensor_obj X.sheaf
      ∀ (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n),
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (f ≫ g)).map
            (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor P N (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) p q n h) ≫

        ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.module_pullback_tensor (f ≫ g)))
          (P.X p) (N.X q)).hom ≫

            (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (f ≫ g)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
            (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (f ≫ g)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj N)
            (curriedTensor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)))

    let β := Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso
      ((conjugateIsoEquiv
        (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (f ≫ g)))
        ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).comp
          (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f)))).symm
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).symm) (.up ℤ)
    (((DerivedCategory.Qh (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))).map (β.hom.app
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ)).obj P))) ⊗ₘ
      ((DerivedCategory.Qh (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))).map (β.hom.app
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ)).obj N)))) ≫
      pullbackTensorModelMap X (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (f ≫ g)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj P) (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (f ≫ g)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up
      ℤ)).obj N) =

      (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj

        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map ψ.inv) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))).map (β.hom.app
